process ALDY_GENOTYPE {
    tag "${meta.id}"
    label 'process_single'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container
        ? 'https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/e8/e8ad9095fa0372544cb2c9d868620c5c5226b7c6504fa3c59a879d73bef52e1d/data'
        : 'community.wave.seqera.io/library/mappy_pysam_gcc_pip_pruned:76bc0744bd24414b'}"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(input), path(index), val(gene), val(profile)
    tuple val(meta2), path(fasta)

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("*.aldy"), emit: aldy
    tuple val(meta), path("*.log"), emit: log
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('aldy'), eval("aldy help 2>&1 | grep -o 'Aldy v[0-9.]*' | cut -c7-"), topic: versions, emit: versions_aldy

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    def reference = fasta ? "--reference ${fasta}" : ''
    """
    aldy \\
        genotype \\
        ${args} \\
        --gene ${gene} \\
        --profile ${profile} \\
        ${reference} \\
        --output ${prefix}.aldy \\
        --log ${prefix}.log \\
        ${input}
    """

    stub:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    echo ${args}

    touch ${prefix}.aldy
    touch ${prefix}.log
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/aldy/genotype"
description: "Genotype and phase pharmacogenes using star-allele nomenclature"
keywords:
- "pharmacogenomics"
- "star-allele"
- "genotyping"
- "phasing"
- "cyp2d6"
tools:
- aldy:
    description: "Allelic decomposition and exact genotyping of highly polymorphic\
      \ and structurally variant pharmacogenes"
    homepage: "https://github.com/0xTCG/aldy"
    documentation: "https://aldy.readthedocs.io/en/latest/"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/0xTCG/aldy"
    doi: "10.1101/gr.277075.122"
    licence:
    - "Aldy/IURTC License (free for academic/non-commercial use)"
    identifier: ""
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - input:
      type: "file"
      description: "Alignment (SAM/BAM/CRAM) or variant (VCF) file mapped to hg19\
        \ or hg38"
      pattern: "*.{sam,bam,cram,vcf,vcf.gz}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2573"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2572"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3462"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3016"
  - index:
      type: "file"
      description: "Index of the input file"
      pattern: "*.{bai,crai,csi,tbi}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3327"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3616"
  - gene:
      type: "string"
      description: "Gene (or comma-separated list of genes) to genotype, e.g. `CYP2D6`.\n\
        Use `all` to genotype every supported gene.\n"
  - profile:
      type: "string"
      description: "Name of the built-in sequencing profile matching the technology\
        \ used\nto generate the input\n"
      pattern: "illumina|wgs|pgx1|pgx2|pgx3|pgrnseq-v1|pgrnseq-v2|pgrnseq-v3|10x|exome|wxs|wes|pacbio-hifi-targeted|pacbio-hifi-targeted-twist"
- - meta2:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing reference information\ne.g. `[ id:'genome'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - fasta:
      type: "file"
      description: "Reference genome FASTA file, required for CRAM input"
      pattern: "*.{fa,fasta,fna}{,.gz}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1929"
output:
  aldy:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.aldy':
        type: "file"
        description: "Tab-separated file with the star-allele decomposition of each\
          \ solution"
        pattern: "*.aldy"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
  log:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.log':
        type: "file"
        description: "Aldy log file"
        pattern: "*.log"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2330"
  versions_aldy:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - aldy:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - aldy help 2>&1 | grep -o 'Aldy v[0-9.]*' | cut -c7-:
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - aldy:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - aldy help 2>&1 | grep -o 'Aldy v[0-9.]*' | cut -c7-:
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
